title: First-run visual clarity pass for onboarding assets (contrast + iconography)
creator: Lena Ortiz
description: Objective: Improve legibility and signposting across the onboarding quickstart screens and accompanying documentation visuals when users are in dark or low-light display modes. This ticket covers a parity pass across iconography, color contrast, alt text for screenshots, and export-ready assets for engineering and docs. It prioritizes first-run flows (signup -> first project -> first inference) and the quickstart cheat-sheet used in the docs site. Scope excludes deep rework of illustrations; focus is pixel-level clarity, global token contrasts, and accessible naming conventions.
acceptance_criteria: All onboarding core screens meet WCAG AA contrast ratios for text and icons at typical sizes (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for UI components where applicable)
Primary action and secondary action affordances maintain perceptible separation in dark-mode and high-ambient-light conditions
Iconography set exported in 24px and 32px raster (PNG) and optimized SVGs with explicit fill/stroke tokens and accessible title/desc tags
Docs screenshots include alt text and a naming standard; updated quickstart doc pages reference the new assets
Design tokens and figma components updated with dark-mode overrides and a short migration guide for engineering
Signoff from Accessibility reviewer and Product Manager recorded in comments
tasks: Audit existing onboarding steps and collect current assets (screenshots, SVGs, microicons)
Run automated contrast checks on text layers and icon glyphs in Figma; list failing layers
Adjust color tokens for dark-theme palette to meet contrast targets; create token variants
Simplify icon strokes and remove fine hairlines not readable at 24px in dark mode
Export new asset bundles with naming convention and create a lightweight CDN manifest for docs
Update quickstart docs screenshots and add alt text entries in the docs repo
Prepare handoff zip and PR with migration notes for engineering
Collect feedback from PM, accessibility lead, and one external beta user
screenshot_guidelines: Use 16:9 and 4:3 crops for hero and inline images respectively
Export PNGs at 2x (retina) and web-optimized WEBP fallbacks
Include concise alt text: 10-20 words describing the visual and the call-to-action visible
Avoid overlays with < 60% opacity on top of key text; prefer separate caption elements

notes: Trade-offs: to hit contrast goals we slightly increased primary CTA saturation which reduces vibrancy of some brand hues in dark mode. PM approved this for accessibility gains. We intentionally avoided large illustration reworks to meet Q2 schedule; separate epic required for illustration refresh. All SVGs will include <title> and <desc> fields for screen-reader friendliness; engineering asked to also include aria-hidden where decorative.
